Overwork is not a badge of honor.

Somehow we’ve reached a point where having a medical emergency at 29, going back to work weeks later, and calling it “leadership” is treated like inspiration instead of a warning sign.

In this video, we break down the corporate obsession with grinding through illness, layoffs, and burnout — and why Business Insider articles, CEOs, and executives keep framing suffering as strength.
